newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius 1996 inflation 6.6 pct vs 6.0 pct in 95.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius 1996 inflation 6.6 pct vs 6.0 pct in 95.

text.p: Mauritius inflation for the calendar year 1996 was 6.6 percent against 6.0 percent in 1995, the economic planning ministry said on Wednesday.
The ministry said that price increases in a wide range of food items, alcoholic drinks and tobacco were the main contributors to inflation.
It said the largest price increases in 1996 were recorded in June owing to a rise in sales tax from 5.0 percent to 8.0 percent during that month.
